Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansEnabled_toolti:
Free groups choose goals such as supplies or shelter, discuss them and follow through until done, blocked, hurt or threatened. Off: groups return to travelling and idling.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansRadius_tooltip:
Sets how far a group looks for a building to visit for its plan. Nearby buildings are preferred; 80 limits the search to 80 tiles.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansLifespanHours_:
Sets how long a group keeps a plan before giving up and choosing again. Shelter plans last until morning.
Default 6.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PlansTalk_tooltip:
Groups discuss plans before leaving and speak when they arrive or give up. Off: they still follow plans, but silently.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunsVsZombiesPercen: How often an NPC that could shoot a zombie does so. Gunfire draws more zombies, so lowering this makes NPCs walk around zombies, use melee on a lone one, and keep their guns for NPCs and players. They still shoot when cornered, hurt, defending a hurt player, on a horde that blocks the way, or on duty as military or police. 0 means never unless cornered. 100 is the old behaviour. Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies: [Expert] No gunfire with this many zombies near
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunNoiseZombies_too: An NPC holds fire when more than this many zombies are within 25 tiles, unless it is cornered, hurt or defending a hurt player. 0 turns the check off. Default 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize: [Expert] Horde size that may be shot
Sandbox_ProjectALife.GunHordeSize_toolti: A group of at least this many zombies within 12 tiles that blocks an NPC's route may be shot at, if it is not too loud (see the noise limit). Default 5.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcShotNoise: [Expert] How far NPC gunshots are heard (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NpcShotNoise_toolti: Scales how far zombies and others hear NPC gunfire. At 50, a shot carries half as far. Players and NPCs hear the same reduced range. Lower it on busy servers where NPC shooting pulls hordes across the map. Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedPerTown_tooltip:
Sets how many travelling groups each town receives when the world starts. The distant travelling group limit may allow extra groups in larger worlds.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SeedClearTiles_tool:
Prevents starting travelling groups from being placed this close to a player. Groups may still arrive later. At 0, this starting clearance is disabled.
Default 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.NeighbourGroups_too:
Blocks new travelling groups when this many already live within 240 tiles. From day 4, the limit drops by one but never below one.
Default 4.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HibernateTiles_tool:
Beyond this distance (60-400 tiles), groups stop travelling, planning and using supplies. Members and loot stay; groups wake on approach without catching up missed time.
Default 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RespawnCooldownDays: Local replacement delay after deaths (game days)

Blocks new travelling groups in an area of about 120 tiles after NPC deaths. Heavy losses extend the delay. At 0, this delay is disabled.
Default 3.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays: Local recovery interval (game days per group)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RegrowthDays_toolti:
After the death cooldown, limits a recovering area to one new group per interval. At 0, this additional recovery limit is disabled.
Default 2.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFairnessEnable:
Keeps spawning, waking and removal away from nearby or watching players. Also reduces rural encounters and prevents checkpoints near players or on dead-end roads.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnKeepOutTiles_t:
Keeps random groups from appearing this close or in view. Countryside adds 10 tiles; loaded-map limits still apply. Groups appear outside the clearance and walk in. Too high a value leaves almost no room to appear inside the loaded map.
Default 45.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnStartGraceMinu:
Lets welcome and starting-town groups appear nearby during a new character's first minutes. Other groups still obey the normal player clearance.
Default 10.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LifecycleReloadGuar:
Restores NPCs after map reloads, removes leftover zombie copies out of sight and clears zombies around returning groups. Blocked groups return farther away. Off removes this protection.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnDespawnMinTile:
NPCs can become inactive or be removed only when they are at least this far from every player and out of sight.
Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity: Countryside encounter rate (percent of town rate)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnRuralDensity_t:
Sets open-countryside encounters relative to towns. At 50, the rate is half the town rate. Only suitable visitors, such as travellers and hunters, appear.
Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnWildernessDens: Wilderness encounter rate (percent of town rate)

Sets forest and wilderness encounters relative to towns. At 30, the rate is 30 percent of the town rate.
Default 30.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity: Farmland encounter rate (percent of town rate)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnFarmDensity_to:
Sets farm and ranch encounters relative to towns. At 60, the rate is 60 percent of the town rate.
Default 60.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.SpawnCheckpointMinT: Blockades and checkpoints are never built within this distance of a player, a player base or a place a player drove through in the last five minutes, and never on dead-end roads. Default 150.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodEnabled_toolti:
Adds floor splatter, bleeding drips and death pools, respecting the game's blood settings. Off: only the game's ordinary splatter and body stains remain.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodPercent_toolti:
Scales floor splatter, body stains, drips and pools from non-melee deaths. At 100, only the earlier body-stain behavior remains.
Default 200.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.BloodMeleeKillPerce: [Expert] NPC blood when killed in melee (%%)
Size of the blood pool when an NPC is killed with a blade, bat or other melee weapon, and the blood on the attacker. Only used while the NPC blood amount is above 100%%. Default 300%%.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingEnabled_tool:
Allows NPCs to react to world sounds and notice nearby players who run or shoot.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingRadiusPercen:
Scales how far NPCs hear sounds. At 50, hearing distance is halved. Indoor player sounds and NPC gunshots use half the resulting range.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingWallPercent_:
Sets how much hearing distance remains when a wall blocks the sound's path. At 50, a blocked sound can be heard from half as far away.
Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingFloorPercent:
Reduces hearing distance for each floor between the NPC and sound. At 50, one floor leaves half the range; two floors leave one quarter.
Default 50.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingPeripheralTi:
Lets NPCs notice a running or recently shooting player behind them on the same floor. At 0, this rear detection is disabled.
Default 8.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertSeconds:
Sets how long extra awareness from sounds and warnings lasts before the NPC returns to its normal awareness.
Default 20.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.HearingAlertPercent:
Sets the minimum awareness after an NPC hears a sound. Confirmed contacts and final warnings still give full awareness.
Default 70.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRoutin: Walking NPCs take short detours around nearby zombie crowds and fresh combat or loud noises. They wait or abandon an unsafe destination when no safe detour is found. Running and combat movement keep their existing rules.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionHazardCheck_: Checks proposed movement legs for burning tiles, lit campfires and water. NPCs reject legs with known hazards. Applies to all movement paces.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays: Danger avoidance sight checks (per real second)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CautionDangerRays_t:
Limits extra sight checks for danger detours across all NPCs. Groups wait when the limit is reached. At 0, these extra checks stop; normal perception is unaffected.
Default 32.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.FireManeuver_toolti: Shooters can advance to nearby cover and briefly step out to fire. Eligible squad gunners provide bounded covering fire. Turning this off cancels active maneuvers.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.ForwardCoverTiles_t: Maximum length of a forward cover leg. Default 4; range 2-6. Weapon distance and movement safety still apply.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PeekWindow_tooltip: Time at the firing point before returning to cover. Default 1200; range 600-2000. At most two shots; weapon cycles finish normally.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.PinWindow_tooltip: Maximum covering fire time for one squad maneuver. Default 4000; range 2000-6000. Requires an eligible gunner and a clear friendly-safe line.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.RetreatLOS_tooltip: Prefer nearby retreat destinations that hide the NPC from the threat. Existing retreat triggers, stamina and fallback destinations remain in use.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatJeemResidents: Expose living Jeem residents as residents through the A-Life compatibility API when the Jeem extension is active. Needs an available actor registry. Does not replace the Companion Dogs patch. Applied at world startup; restart after changing this.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPointBlank_to: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Point Blank is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatWanderingZomb: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Wandering Zombies is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCyesPushDoors: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Cye's Push Doors is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatMoreTraits_to: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when More Traits Definitive is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatProjectExile_: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Project Exile is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatPixelStrike_t: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Pixel Strike Indicator is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatGaelGunStore_: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when GaelGunStore-Firearms is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatRVInterior_to: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Project RV Interior is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAdvancedTraje: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Advanced Trajectory is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatAutoAll_toolt: Enable the A-Life compatibility adapter when Auto All is active. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Turning it off disables only this adapter, not the other mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatCryOfFear_too: Let Cry of Fear monsters bite A-Life people when their own attack animation never starts, at the same pace as ordinary zombies. Applied once at world startup; restart after changing this. Does nothing without the monsters mod.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot: [Expert] No pocket loot on A-Life people
Sandbox_ProjectALife.CompatNoPocketLoot_:
Mark A-Life people as already searched when they appear, so the vanilla zombie pocket loot is not rolled on their bodies. Off keeps the vanilla loot. Use it with mods that add loot to zombies.
Default off.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsBuildBudget:
Maximum work units per round. Higher values finish sooner but may increase server stalls. Multiplayer streaming pauses still apply.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsMaxCompound:
Limits new walled compounds. At 0, none are proposed. Existing sites, small camps, checkpoints and admin-built sites stay.
Default 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsCompoundSpa:
Minimum distance between new walled compounds. Recently expired sites count until cleared. Small camps and fixed checkpoints are unchanged.
Default 500.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.OutpostsLightsOn_to:
Keeps campfires, lamps and generators in outposts, compounds, checkpoints and camps burning and switched on, refuelled while a player is near. Off leaves them as built.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent: NPC loot: how much of their gear stays on bodies (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcDropPercent_:
Chance that each item an NPC carried stays on its body. 100 means everything they carried drops (the default); lower values leave emptier bodies. Use the wear setting below to make drops poorer instead. A fixed NPC weapon drop chance overrides this for weapons.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent: NPC loot: how worn out dropped gear is (percent)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWearPercent_:
Gear on NPC bodies comes out used up: many guns are broken or nearly so, magazines are almost empty, clothes and vests are tattered, loose ammo is scarce. NPCs still fight with working weapons while alive; the wear is applied when they die. 0 leaves everything pristine, 100 is full wear.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcWeaponPercen: [Expert] NPC loot: weapons (percent of the loot setting)

Multiplies the NPC loot percent for guns and melee weapons. Ignored while NPC weapon drop chance is a fixed choice. For example, 50 halves weapon drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcArmorPercent: [Expert] NPC loot: armor and clothing (percent of the loot setting)

Multiplies the NPC loot percent for worn armor and clothing, including rare armor. For example, 50 halves armor drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent: [Expert] NPC loot: magazines and ammo (percent of the loot setting)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcAmmoPercent_:
Multiplies the NPC loot percent for dropped magazines and loose ammo. For example, 50 halves ammo drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.LootNpcSuppliesPerc: [Expert] NPC loot: supplies and other items (percent of the loot setting)

Multiplies the NPC loot percent for food, medicine, tools and pocket items; identity cards always stay. For example, 50 halves supply drops.
Default 100.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Persons_to:
Door visits bring named individuals and small groups with their own history, needs and conversation. Off: visits work exactly as before.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_ProactiveE: Guests speak up on their own

How often a guest inside your home starts talking by themselves, for example asking about the TV. Rare waits longer, Often waits less. Off: guests only answer when you talk.
Default Normal (3).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_EventMinGa: Shortest pause between a guest's own questions (real seconds)

Real seconds that must pass after a guest speaks up before the same player is prompted again. Higher is calmer.
Default 240.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_StayHours: Longest stay of a guest (game hours)
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_StayHours_:
A guest never stays inside longer than this. Most guests leave sooner. Raise it to let people ask to stay for a few nights; more time inside means more risk and more help.
Default 1.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Parties: Couples, families and small groups arrive together
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Parties_to:
Pairs and trios of related people can knock together instead of one stranger at a time. Off: one visitor per visit.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_ReturningC: Chance that a visitor you befriended comes back (percent)

Once you have really helped someone, this chance decides whether a later visit is that person coming back. 0 means never.
Default 15.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Life: Guests move about, sit, read and look out of windows
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Life_toolt:
Guests inside your home walk around, sit on furniture, read and look out of windows instead of standing where they were let in. Off: they stand still.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_ChangeClot:
Adult guests can ask for clean clothes and change in a closed room, down to the default body and never beyond. Off: no clothes changes.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Privacy: Privacy when a guest changes clothes
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Privacy_to:
Strict: a guest only changes in a room with the door shut, and not while you stand near the door. Normal: the door may be open.
Default Strict (1).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Flirt_tool:
Adult guests can show gentle, optional, non-explicit warmth after real trust and always accept a no. Off: no flirting at all.
Default On (2).
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Books: Guests read books and talk about them
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Books_tool:
Guests can carry and read books and newspapers and discuss them with you. Off: no book conversations.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_ChatMirror: Show guest speech in the chat box

Words spoken by guests also appear in the chat window, not only as speech bubbles. Needs the chat mirror of the talk interface.
Default on.
Sandbox_ProjectALife.Visitors_Debug_tool:
Adds extra visitor lines to the QA dump and the flight recorder to help find problems. Leave off for normal play.
Default off.
